Handoff · join-tenant-v3-capabilities.html

Join invite, capabilities edition

Everything needed to build the workspace invite page in the truex app: layout, tokens, every component and state, the capabilities board recipes, assets, copy, and the acceptance checklist. Values are copied from the prototype. Anything marked proposal is not in the prototype and needs a product or backend decision.

Prototype: design/join-tenant-v3-capabilities.htmlTarget: app.tsx + index.htmlOct 1, 2026

Overview

This page is the invite landing for truex agents. Someone opens an invite link, sees who invited them and to which workspace, and joins. The source prototype is design/join-tenant-v3-capabilities.html.

The page has one job: accept the invite by entering your name and pressing Join. Everything else supports that job or explains what the person gets after joining.

Two panes

  • Left, the invitation (.left): brand header, a one-line "who invited you" row with an expiry pill, the headline "Take your seat at Northwind Labs", and the join card. The join card holds a 3-step progress checkup, the locked work email, the name input, the Join button and fine print.
  • Right, the capabilities board (aside.right): a dotted specimen sheet with eight numbered objects, one per truex capability, and a legend underneath. The board is decorative (aria-hidden="true"). The legend is the readable version. Specimen 07 ("You") mirrors the name as it is typed.

Prototype-only controls

  • The "Preview state" segmented control in .foot (Valid invite / Expired / Already a member) is a design-review tool. Do not ship it. In production the state comes from the invite lookup.
  • The theme segmented control in the header (Auto / Light / Dark) is also a review tool. It mirrors the app's useTheme() hook in app.tsx: same localStorage key "truex-theme", value "" for Auto, "light" or "dark", applied as data-theme on <html> (removed for Auto). In production, reuse useTheme() and do not add a second theme store.
  • The ?theme=light|dark query param override is prototype-only (used for screenshots). Do not ship it.

Board sizing

The board is sized by two nested container queries. .board-wrap is a size container that fills whatever height is left between the head and the legend. The board takes the largest width that fits both axes and caps at 560px: min(100cqw, 560px, 100cqh * 5 / 5.4), with aspect-ratio: 5 / 5.4. The board is itself an inline-size container, so every specimen position, size and font inside it is in % or cqw and scales with the board. Specimen positions are absolute percentages of the board.

On desktop the page itself must never scroll. .split is locked to 100dvh and the right panel is overflow: hidden, so the board shrinks to fit. Only the left column may scroll, and only on short viewports.

Color tokens

Theme selectors

Tokens are defined in three states, the same pattern as index.html:

  1. :root holds light values and color-scheme: light.
  2. @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { :root:not([data-theme="light"]) { ... } } applies dark values when the OS is dark and the user has not forced light (Auto).
  3. :root[data-theme="dark"] { ... } applies the same dark values when the user forces dark, regardless of OS.

Blocks 2 and 3 are identical and both set color-scheme: dark. data-theme="light" needs no block of its own: it only disables block 2.

Agent tints

Fixed hex. No dark variant: they are defined once on :root and are not redefined in either dark block. Content on tint fills uses --tint-ink.

TintSoft fillDot
ice --ice #EAF5F8 --ice-dot #3691CD
mint --mint #E7F4ED --mint-dot #A9D5BE
butter --butter #FFF3D9 --butter-dot #EBCB8B
peach --peach #FBE9DD --peach-dot #F0B999
lilac --lilac #EFEDF8 --lilac-dot #C4BDE3
ink on tints --tint-ink #1F2A30

The profile aura (specimen 07) picks its colors from the name with a hash: h = [...name].reduce((a, c) => (a * 31 + c.charCodeAt(0)) >>> 0, 7), a = h % 5, b = (a + 1 + (h >> 4) % 4) % 5, over the order ice, mint, butter, peach, lilac. --a1 is dot[a], --a2 is dot[b], --a3 is soft[a].

All shared color values match in light and dark. Two differences:

Typography

Fonts

  • Figtree, weights 400, 500, 600, 700, 800. Token --font-sans. Base: font: 14px/1.5 var(--font-sans), -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased.
  • Newsreader, italic only, optical size 6..72, weights 400..500. Token --font-accent. Used for the italic accent words and the board signature.
  • JetBrains Mono, weights 400 and 500. Token --font-mono. Used for eyebrows, hints, counts and all board labels.
https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Figtree:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=Newsreader:ital,opsz,wght@1,6..72,400..500&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap

index.html already loads the same three families (plus Caveat), so no new font request is needed in the app.

Focus

  • Global: :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-2); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 8px; }
  • Input: .input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent-2); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft); }
  • Legend items are focusable (tabindex="0"). Focus and hover both give background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 70%, transparent) and highlight the matching board specimen (others drop to opacity: .3, the hot one scales to 1.04).

Left pane components

These are listed top to bottom as they render in .left. The left pane uses display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 8px 28px 20px, which becomes 8px 16px 12px below 960px. The invite column .invite has max-width: 460px, is centered, and uses padding-block: clamp(20px, 7vh, 72px) 20px, gap: 20px and a rise .35s ease-out entry animation. The base font is 14px/1.5 var(--font-sans) (Figtree).

Form logic

Rules as coded

const clean    = (s) => s.trim().replace(/\s+/g, " ");
const initials = (n) => n.split(" ").filter(Boolean).map(w => w[0]).slice(0, 2).join("").toUpperCase();
const isValid  = (n) => n.length >= 2 && /\p{L}/u.test(n);
  • Whitespace: clean() trims the value and collapses runs of whitespace into one space. It runs on every input event and on submit. The cleaned value is the one sent and displayed.
  • Validity: the cleaned name must be at least 2 characters long (UTF-16 length) and contain at least one Unicode letter (\p{L}). "A1" is valid. "12" and "--" are not.
  • Initials: take the first character of each of the first two words and uppercase them. "alex rivera jones" gives "AR". "Cher" gives "C".
  • Input limits: maxlength="60", autocomplete="name", required. The form uses novalidate, so all validation is in JS.
  • Input events are ignored when the state is not valid, while busy, or after joining.
  • Submit is ignored while busy.
  • First name in the joined banner is name.split(" ")[0], passed through escapeHTML, which escapes & < > " '. Only this banner is built with innerHTML from user input. Every other place uses textContent. In production, render with the framework's text binding and skip innerHTML.

Profile specimen aura hash

const AURA      = ["--ice-dot", "--mint-dot", "--butter-dot", "--peach-dot", "--lilac-dot"];
const AURA_SOFT = ["--ice", "--mint", "--butter", "--peach", "--lilac"];

const h = [...name].reduce((a, c) => (a * 31 + c.charCodeAt(0)) >>> 0, 7);
const a = h % 5, b = (a + 1 + (h >> 4) % 4) % 5;
// --a1 = var(AURA[a]), --a2 = var(AURA[b]), --a3 = var(AURA_SOFT[a])

Tint values: --ice #EAF5F8 / --ice-dot #3691CD, --mint #E7F4ED / --mint-dot #A9D5BE, --butter #FFF3D9 / --butter-dot #EBCB8B, --peach #FBE9DD / --peach-dot #F0B999, --lilac #EFEDF8 / --lilac-dot #C4BDE3. These are fixed and have no dark variant. The empty-state fallback is butter-dot / peach-dot / butter.

Bug in the prototype: h is an unsigned 32-bit value, but h >> 4 is a signed shift. When h >= 2^31 the result is negative, so b can equal a or become negative (for example AURA[-2] is undefined, which gives var(undefined)). Use (h >>> 4) % 4 in production. This keeps b in the range 0 to 4 and different from a. If the hash also drives the real profile color, compute it in one shared place so the invite and the app agree.

Accessibility announcements

  • <p class="sr" aria-live="polite" id="live"> receives: each submit phase label, "Joined Northwind Labs", and "Opening Northwind Labs".
  • Nothing is announced when the invite request is sent or when the name error appears. The error is linked to the input through aria-describedby and focus moves to the input. Consider announcing "Request sent" as well.
  • The progress bar updates aria-valuenow (0 to 3).
  • prefers-reduced-motion: reduce cuts every animation and transition to .01ms.

Production wiring

The prototype hard-codes the following. Developers need to implement each item.

  • Invite token lookup: inviter name, title and avatar tint; workspace name and logo initial; role; sent date; expiry; invited email; and whether the signed-in user is already a member. This lookup decides the page state (valid, expired, member, invalid).
  • Accept endpoint: replaces the three 700ms fake phases. Keep the phase labels as progress feedback, but tie completion to the response rather than a timer.
  • Request-new-invite endpoint: backs "Request a new invite" in the Expired state.
  • "Switch account": in the prototype it only calls preventDefault(). It should sign the user out and return to sign-in with the invite token kept (for example as a returnTo param).
  • Terms link: href="#" today. It needs the workspace terms URL.
  • "Open Northwind Labs": today it only changes the label to "Opening…". It should navigate to the workspace (the first conversation, per phase 3 copy).
  • Expiry pill: "Expires in 6 days" and "Expired Sep 23" are static. Derive them from expiresAt and server time (send serverNow so client clock skew does not matter). The "Invites last 7 days" copy should come from the invite TTL.
  • Mock data mismatch: the sub line says "sent Sep 24" while the expired copy says "expired on Sep 23". Real data will not have this problem, but QA should not copy these dates as fixtures.

Proposed payload types

Proposal only. These types do not match any existing API. Align names with the backend before building.
// PROPOSAL - not an existing API
type InviteStatus = "valid" | "expired" | "revoked" | "invalid" | "already_member";

interface InvitePayload {
  token: string;
  status: InviteStatus;
  workspace: {
    id: string;
    name: string;            // "Northwind Labs"
    logoInitial: string;     // "N"
    memberCount: number;     // used by the board ("+11 teammates")
  };
  inviter: {
    id: string;
    name: string;            // "Maya Chen"
    title?: string;          // "Head of Research"
    avatarTint?: "ice" | "mint" | "butter" | "peach" | "lilac";
    isAdmin: boolean;        // shows the verified badge
  };
  role: "member" | "admin" | "guest";   // role pill text
  invitedEmail: string;      // "alex@northwind.dev"
  sentAt: string;            // ISO 8601
  expiresAt: string;         // ISO 8601
  serverNow: string;         // ISO 8601, for the countdown
  viewer?: {                 // present when signed in
    email: string;
    name?: string;           // prefill for the name field
    memberSince?: string;    // for "member since Aug"
  };
}

interface AcceptInviteRequest {
  token: string;
  displayName: string;       // clean()ed, 2-60 chars, contains a letter
}

type AcceptInviteResponse =
  | { ok: true; workspaceId: string; redirectUrl: string; member: { id: string; displayName: string } }
  | { ok: false; error: "invite_expired" | "invite_revoked" | "invite_invalid"
        | "email_mismatch" | "already_member" | "invalid_name" | "rate_limited" };

interface RequestNewInviteRequest { token: string; }
interface RequestNewInviteResponse { ok: boolean; notifiedInviter: boolean; }

Header

  • H2: What you can do in <em>truex</em>. 20px / 1.2, weight 600, letter-spacing -.02em, margin 0. The em is Newsreader italic 400 in --accent-fg (#2A72A3 light, #BCDEE8 dark).
  • Sub copy: "Eight things waiting on the other side of that button." 13px, --ink-3, margin 4px 0 0, max-width 40ch.
  • Tag, right aligned: "NORTHWIND · 04 AGENTS". JetBrains Mono 11px, --ink-3, letter-spacing .04em, nowrap.
  • Row: .right-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; }

Production: "NORTHWIND" is the workspace name (uppercased) and "04" is the workspace agent count, zero-padded to 2 digits.

Coordinate system

.board-wrap { flex: 1; min-height: 0; margin-top: 8px; container-type: size; display: grid; place-items: center; }
@media (max-width: 960px) { .board-wrap { flex: none; container-type: inline-size; } }
.board { position: relative; width: min(100cqw, 560px, 100cqh * 5 / 5.4); aspect-ratio: 5 / 5.4; container-type: inline-size; }
@media (max-width: 520px) { .board { aspect-ratio: 5 / 6.4; } }
  • The board is a 5:5.4 box (5:6.4 under 520px). It fits the free space of .board-wrap and never exceeds 560px wide.
  • Every specimen is position: absolute with left/top as a percentage of the board.
  • Sizes use cqw, where 1cqw = 1% of the board width, because .board is itself an inline-size container. The whole composition scales as one piece.
  • Text and small controls use max(Npx, Mcqw) so they never shrink below a readable pixel floor, for example max(12px, 2.8cqw) on the timer.

Materials

Five reusable recipes. Specimens combine them by class.

Clover clip-path

A four-lobed water-lily shape in object-bounding-box units, so one path fits any box. Defined once in a hidden SVG at the top of body.

<svg width="0" height="0" style="position:absolute" aria-hidden="true">
  <clipPath id="clover" clipPathUnits="objectBoundingBox">
    <path d="M.5,.1 C.82,-.1 1.1,.18 .9,.5 C1.1,.82 .82,1.1 .5,.9 C.18,1.1 -.1,.82 .1,.5 C-.1,.18 .18,-.1 .5,.1Z"/>
  </clipPath>
</svg>

.clover { clip-path: url(#clover); position: relative; overflow: hidden; }

Used by: 01 agent, 03 lotus petals (.lotus i), 06 portrait, 07 profile.

.glass (frosted glass)

.glass { position: relative; overflow: hidden;
  background: linear-gradient(150deg, var(--glass-hi), var(--glass) 70%);
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-line);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(150%); backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(150%);
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 var(--sheen), inset 0 -12px 22px -14px rgb(0 0 0 / 22%), var(--obj-shadow); }
.glass::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: inherit;
  background: linear-gradient(112deg, transparent 38%, rgb(255 255 255 / 28%) 50%, transparent 62%);
  translate: -130% 0; animation: sweep 11s ease-in-out var(--sw, 0s) infinite; pointer-events: none; }
@keyframes sweep { 0%, 72% { translate: -130% 0; } 100% { translate: 130% 0; } }
TokenLightDark
--glassrgb(255 255 255 / 38%)rgb(255 255 255 / 4%)
--glass-hirgb(255 255 255 / 78%)rgb(255 255 255 / 13%)
--glass-linergb(31 42 48 / 9%)rgb(255 255 255 / 11%)
--sheenrgb(255 255 255 / 85%)rgb(255 255 255 / 22%)
--obj-shadow0 1px 1px rgb(31 42 48 / 5%), 0 14px 30px -12px rgb(31 42 48 / 24%)0 1px 1px rgb(0 0 0 / 40%), 0 18px 36px -12px rgb(0 0 0 / 75%)

The sweep highlight crosses once per 11s cycle (idle for the first 72%). --sw offsets it per specimen: 02 and 03 use 0s, 04 uses 3s, 08 uses 6s. Used by: 02 pill, 03 tile, 04 orb, 08 tile.

.grain (film grain)

.grain::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--noise);
  mix-blend-mode: overlay; opacity: .55; pointer-events: none; border-radius: inherit; z-index: 3; }

--noise: url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='140' height='140'><filter id='n'><feTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='.85' numOctaves='2' stitchTiles='stitch'/><feColorMatrix values='0 0 0 0 .5 0 0 0 0 .5 0 0 0 0 .5 0 0 0 .7 0'/></filter><rect width='100%' height='100%' filter='url(%23n)'/></svg>");

A 140px tile of mid-grey fractal noise at 70% alpha, blended with overlay at .55 opacity. Same value in both themes. The element needs position: relative (or absolute). Used by: bar-a, bar-b, 01 clover, 03 tile, 06 clover, 07 clover.

.lit (top-left light)

.lit::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0;
  background: radial-gradient(120% 90% at 22% 12%, rgb(255 255 255 / 55%), transparent 45%);
  mix-blend-mode: soft-light; pointer-events: none; z-index: 2; }

Used by: 01 clover only.

.drop (object shadow on clipped shapes)

.drop { filter: var(--obj-drop); }
/* light */ --obj-drop: drop-shadow(0 12px 16px rgb(31 42 48 / 14%));
/* dark  */ --obj-drop: drop-shadow(0 16px 20px rgb(0 0 0 / 55%));

box-shadow is cut off by clip-path, so clover shapes get their shadow from a filter: drop-shadow on an unclipped parent. Used on: .s1, .s6 .frame, and the wrapper div.drop around the 07 clover.

Specimens

All specimens share the base class:

.sp { position: absolute; --d: 1;
  transform: translate3d(calc(var(--px, 0) * var(--d) * 1px), calc(var(--py, 0) * var(--d) * 1px), 0);
  transition: transform .8s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), scale .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), opacity .3s;
  animation: float var(--fd, 9s) ease-in-out var(--fdl, 0s) infinite alternate; }
@keyframes float { to { translate: 0 -4px; } }

Parallax uses transform, float uses translate, and legend highlight uses scale. These are independent properties, so all three combine without conflict. Keep them separate in production.

Bars (bar-a, bar-b)

Two lit, grained columns that anchor the middle of the board. No capability and no legend entry.

.bar-a, .bar-b { border-radius: 2.6cqw; overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: inset 1.5px 0 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 38%), inset -8px 0 14px -8px rgb(0 0 0 / 22%), var(--obj-shadow); }
.bar-a { left: 47%; top: 24%; width: 10.5cqw; height: 44%;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--mint-dot) 75%, #fff), var(--mint-dot) 32%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--mint-dot) 62%, #2E4A3A) 100%); }
.bar-b { left: 37.5%; top: 40%; width: 10.5cqw; height: 20%;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--peach) 70%, #fff), var(--peach-dot) 70%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--peach-dot) 80%, #9C5A3C) 100%); }
  • bar-a: mint #A9D5BE, shaded to #2E4A3A. Classes sp bar-a grain.
  • bar-b: peach #FBE9DD to #F0B999, shaded to #9C5A3C. Classes sp bar-b grain.
  • Bars are .sp without data-c, so they also dim to .3 when any legend item is hot.

01 Named agents: living aurora

Capability: agents you can @mention. Markup: .sp.s1.drop > .clover.grain.lit > span.aurora + span.core.

  1. Clover base fill --ice #EAF5F8.
  2. Aurora: four tinted radial blobs over lilac, blurred 12px, rotating 360deg every 24s.
  3. Core: white radial glow in the centre, breathing every 5s.
  4. .lit soft-light highlight (z 2), then .grain (z 3).
.s1 { left: 36%; top: 6%; width: 19cqw; height: 19cqw; }
.s1 .clover { width: 100%; height: 100%; background: var(--ice); }
.aurora { position: absolute; inset: -30%; background:
  radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, var(--peach-dot), transparent 42%),
  radial-gradient(circle at 72% 32%, var(--ice-dot), transparent 44%),
  radial-gradient(circle at 55% 78%, var(--lilac-dot), transparent 46%),
  radial-gradient(circle at 24% 72%, var(--mint-dot), transparent 42%), var(--lilac);
  filter: blur(12px) saturate(115%); animation: spin 24s linear infinite; }
.s1 .core { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; width: 34%; height: 34%; translate: -50% -50%; border-radius: 50%; z-index: 1;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 38% 32%, rgb(255 255 255 / 95%), rgb(255 255 255 / 35%) 42%, transparent 72%);
  filter: blur(1.5px); animation: breathe 5s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes breathe { 50% { scale: .8; opacity: .75; } }

Colours: peach-dot #F0B999, ice-dot #3691CD, lilac-dot #C4BDE3, mint-dot #A9D5BE, lilac #EFEDF8. Static data, no dynamic content.

02 Live sessions: running timer

Capability: agents keep working in the background. Markup: .sp.s2 > .pill.glass > span.live + span#timer.

.s2 { left: 63%; top: 18%; }
.s2 .pill { height: max(30px, 6.6cqw); padding: 0 2.6cqw 0 1.3cqw; border-radius: 999px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 1.6cqw;
  font: 500 max(12px, 2.8cqw) var(--font-mono); color: var(--ink); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }
.s2 .live { position: relative; z-index: 1; width: max(12px, 2.8cqw); height: max(12px, 2.8cqw); border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 36% 30%, #fff 0 10%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--mint-dot) 70%, #fff) 28%, var(--mint-dot) 55%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--mint-dot) 55%, #2E4A3A) 100%);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--mint-dot) 22%, transparent), 0 0 12px color-mix(in srgb, var(--mint-dot) 60%, transparent);
  animation: glow 2.6s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes glow { 50% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px color-mix(in srgb, var(--mint-dot) 6%, transparent), 0 0 20px color-mix(in srgb, var(--mint-dot) 80%, transparent); } }
.s2 .pill > span:last-child { position: relative; z-index: 1; }

Dynamic data: the timer starts at 00:31:23 (1883 s) and ticks every 1000 ms, formatted HH:MM:SS.

let secs = 31 * 60 + 23;
const pad = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, "0");
setInterval(() => { secs++; $("timer").textContent =
  pad(Math.floor(secs / 3600)) + ":" + pad(Math.floor(secs / 60) % 60) + ":" + pad(secs % 60); }, 1000);
Decision for product: in production the timer should either show the elapsed time of a real running session in the workspace, or be explicitly decorative. The prototype value is invented. The interval keeps running under reduced motion; decide whether to freeze it there.

03 Goals and plans: layered lotus

Capability: turn a goal into an editable plan. Markup: .sp.s3 > .tile.glass.grain > .lotus > i*4.

  1. Glass tile, radius 4.6cqw, content centred.
  2. Lotus box at 76% of the tile, z 1.
  3. Four clover-clipped petals, inset 0 / 14% / 28% / 40%. Outer three share a lilac radial; the innermost is a white-to-lilac bud.
  4. Petals 2, 3, 4 pulse (bloom) 6s with delays 0s, -1s, -2s, so they ripple inward.
.s3 { left: 12%; top: 26%; width: 17cqw; height: 17cqw; }

  background: radial-gradient(circle, color-mix(in srgb, var(--lilac-dot) 55%, #3B3160) 18%, var(--lilac-dot) 58%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--lilac) 60%, #fff) 100%); }
.lotus i:nth-child(1) { inset: 0; }
.lotus i:nth-child(2) { inset: 14%; animation: bloom 6s ease-in-out infinite; }

.lotus i:nth-child(4) { inset: 40%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 40% 35%, #fff, color-mix(in srgb, var(--lilac) 70%, #fff) 60%); animation: bloom 6s ease-in-out -2s infinite; }
@keyframes bloom { 50% { scale: .93; } }

Colours: #C4BDE3, #3B3160, #EFEDF8. Static.

Typing updates only in the valid state and not while busy or joined. The profile paints for any non-empty value, even one that is not yet valid (valid = at least 2 characters and one letter). Clean: trim and collapse whitespace. Initials: first letter of the first two words, uppercased.

const AURA = ["--ice-dot", "--mint-dot", "--butter-dot", "--peach-dot", "--lilac-dot"];
const AURA_SOFT = ["--ice", "--mint", "--butter", "--peach", "--lilac"];
const h = [...name].reduce((a, c) => (a * 31 + c.charCodeAt(0)) >>> 0, 7);
const a = h % 5, b = (a + 1 + (h >> 4) % 4) % 5;   // BUG: see note below
clover.style.setProperty("--a1", "var(" + AURA[a] + ")");
clover.style.setProperty("--a2", "var(" + AURA[b] + ")");
clover.style.setProperty("--a3", "var(" + AURA_SOFT[a] + ")");
Fix before shipping: h >> 4 is a signed shift. When h is 231 or more, the result is negative, % 4 returns -3 to 0, and b can equal a or become a negative index (var(undefined), so the second aura color disappears). Use (h >>> 4) % 4. Then b is always one of the four colors other than a.

The same name always gives the same aura. Production: reuse this hash for the user's avatar tint so the board and the app agree. The check icon uses stroke var(--board-bg) so it reads as a knockout.

Parallax

  • Listener: pointermove on .right (the whole panel), measured against the board rect.
  • Offset: --px = ((clientX - rect.left) / rect.width - .5) * -10, and the same for --py on Y. Range is -5 to 5 at the board edges, larger outside the board. Written on #board as unitless numbers.
  • Each .sp moves by --px * --d px and --py * --d px, so items with higher --d (04 at 1.6) move more than the bars (.4). Movement is opposite to the pointer.
  • Easing: transition: transform .8s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1).
  • pointerleave on .right resets both to 0.
  • Not attached when prefers-reduced-motion: reduce matches at load. On touch, pointermove only fires during a drag.
if (!matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches) {
  board.closest(".right").addEventListener("pointermove", (e) => {
    const r = board.getBoundingClientRect();
    board.style.setProperty("--px", (((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width) - .5) * -10);
    board.style.setProperty("--py", (((e.clientY - r.top) / r.height) - .5) * -10);
  });
  board.closest(".right").addEventListener("pointerleave", () => { board.style.setProperty("--px", 0); board.style.setProperty("--py", 0); });
}

Legend highlight

  • mouseenter or focus on a legend li[data-c] adds .has-hot to #board and .is-hot to the .sp with the matching data-c.
  • mouseleave or blur clears both.
  • .board.has-hot .sp:not(.is-hot) { opacity: .3; } (this includes the bars).
  • .sp.is-hot { scale: 1.04; }
  • Legend row hover/focus background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 70%, transparent), transition .15s.

Reduced motion

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after {
  animation-duration: .01ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; transition-duration: .01ms !important; } }

All loops stop, parallax is not bound, and the legend highlight still works (instant). The timer text still ticks.

Legend

ol.legend#legend under the board. It is the accessible, readable version of the board. Each li has tabindex="0" and data-c 1 to 8.

.legend { flex: none; list-style: none; margin: 14px 0 0; padding: 10px 0 0; border-top: 1px dashed var(--line-strong);
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 2px 8px; }
@media (min-width: 1400px) { .legend { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); } }
@media (max-width: 520px) { .legend { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } }
.legend li { display: grid; align-content: start; grid-template-columns: 18px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 1px 4px; padding: 6px; border-radius: 9px; cursor: default; transition: background .15s; }
.legend li:hover, .legend li:focus-visible { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 70%, transparent); }
.legend .n { font: 400 10.5px/18px var(--font-mono); color: var(--ink-3); }
.legend b { font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 18px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -.005em; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }

The li items are focusable but have no action. In production either keep them as plain list items that only drive the highlight, or remove tabindex and rely on hover. "12" in 06 is dynamic (team count).

Assets

There are no raster image files on this page. Everything is CSS gradients, inline SVG and one SVG noise data URI. The only real images needed in production are the teammate portrait (06) and, optionally, the inviter's avatar (the left pane currently shows "MC" initials on a lilac-dot circle).

Accessibility

The prototype already covers most of the basics. Keep all of it and close the gaps listed below. Full WCAG validation still needs manual testing with a screen reader (VoiceOver, NVDA) and an accessibility review. This list does not replace that.

Already in the prototype

  • Every input has a <label for>. The name field has autocomplete="name", maxlength="60" and required.
  • Invalid submit sets aria-invalid="true" on the name input, shows #nameErr (linked with aria-describedby) and moves focus back to the input.
  • The progress bar has role="progressbar", aria-label="Join progress", aria-valuemin="0", aria-valuemax="3", and aria-valuenow is updated on every step.
  • Submit phases and results are announced through a visually hidden aria-live="polite" paragraph (#live).
  • The form is labelled by its eyebrow (aria-labelledby="join-sec-h"). The capabilities panel is an <aside> labelled by its h2.
  • The board is aria-hidden="true". The legend is the readable version of it.
  • The verified badge SVG has aria-label="Verified admin", and its wrapper has title="Workspace admin".
  • :focus-visible ring: 2px solid --accent-2, offset 2px, radius 8px.
  • prefers-reduced-motion: reduce cuts every animation and transition to .01ms, and the parallax listener is never attached.

Gaps to fix in production

IssueFix
Step dots use bare glyphs (✓, !, 2, 3)Hide the glyph with aria-hidden="true" and add visually hidden state text per step, for example "Invite verified, done", "Add your name, current step", "Join workspace, not started".
Progress bar only exposes a numberAdd aria-valuetext, for example "Step 2 of 3: Add your name". In the expired state use "Invite expired".
"Request sent" is not announcedCall the same live-region say() in the expired submit branch.
Error text only appears visuallyKeep focus on the input, and also put role="alert" on #nameErr or announce it through #live.
Legend items are focusable but do nothingEither drop tabindex="0" (the highlight stays on hover) or keep it and accept that focus only drives the highlight. Don't add a button role, because there is no action.
href="#" links (terms, Switch account)Point terms to the real URL. "Switch account" is an action, so make it a <button> styled as a link.
Required state is only impliedKeep required (screen readers say "required"). Add aria-required="true" only if the native attribute is removed.
Readonly email looks like an inputIt is fine as readonly, which stays focusable and readable. Keep the lock icon aria-hidden and keep the "from invite" hint inside the label.
Busy buttonWhile submitting, set aria-busy="true" on the form. The label text changes (the phase names) are already announced by the live region.
Timer (02) ticks every secondIt is inside the aria-hidden board, so it is silent. Keep it out of any live region.

Contrast (computed, WCAG 2.x formula)

Small mono text on the board and hints uses --ink-3. 4.5 : 1 is the target for text under 18px.

Two token issues come from the shared design system, not from this page. First, light --ink-3 is below 4.5 : 1 on both white and the board. Second, white text on --accent is 3.45 : 1. Raise this with design before shipping. Suggested fixes: darken light --ink-3 to about #687479 (about 4.55 : 1 on the board, 4.8 : 1 on white). For the button, --accent-hover (#2A7DB4) still just fails at 4.48 : 1, so use --accent-pressed (#226A9B, about 5.8 : 1) as the resting fill and pick a darker hover. Ratios use the WCAG 2.x luminance formula.

Keyboard order

  1. Theme segmented control: Auto, Light, Dark (prototype only; in the app, theme comes from settings)
  2. Work email (readonly, focusable)
  3. Your name
  4. Join button (Enter in the name field also submits)
  5. Workspace terms link
  6. Switch account
  7. Preview state control (prototype only, remove)
  8. Legend items 01 to 08 (only if tabindex is kept)

On load, move focus to the name field when the invite is valid. In the expired and member states, focus the primary button.

Performance

AreaWhat the prototype doesRecommendation
Backdrop blur5 elements use backdrop-filter: 02 pill, 03 tile and 08 tile (blur 18px), the 04 orb (blur 5px), and the 06 plus badge (blur 10px).Fine on desktop. On low-end devices or when backdrop-filter is unsupported, the gradient fill alone still reads as glass, so no fallback work is needed. Don't add more glass layers.
Infinite animationsAbout 23 running loops: float on all 10 .sp items, aurora spin, core breathe, live-dot glow, 3 lotus blooms, 4 glass sweeps, the 05 edge light, the 07 aura spin and the 07 empty shimmer.All are transform, opacity, background-position or box-shadow, so they are cheap except box-shadow (the 02 glow). Pause the board when the tab is hidden (visibilitychange) or scrolled off-screen on mobile (IntersectionObserver) by toggling a class that sets animation-play-state: paused on .board *.
TimersetInterval every 1000ms, forever.Clear it when the component unmounts. Pause it together with the animations when the board is hidden.
Blur filtersfilter: blur() on the aurora (12px), the aura (10px), the portrait (4px) and the core (1.5px), each also rotating or scaling.Add will-change: transform only to .aurora and .aura, the two rotating blurred layers. Don't put it on every .sp.
Noise textureOne SVG feTurbulence data URI, used as a background by 6 grained elements.The browser rasterises it once per element. If profiling shows cost, export it to a 140×140 PNG (a few KB) and reference that file instead.
ParallaxSets two custom properties on every pointermove.Throttle with requestAnimationFrame. Only attach on (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine).
Container queriescontainer-type: size on .board-wrap and inline-size on .board, with cqw and cqh units.Supported in all current evergreen browsers. No fallback planned. If an older Safari (below 16) must be supported, set .board { width: min(100%, 560px) } as the default before the container rule.
color-mix()Used in 02, 03, 05, 07, 08, the bars and the legend hover.Supported in current browsers. The same Safari 16.2+ floor applies.
Viewport heightheight: 100vh; height: 100dvh on .split.Keep both lines. 100vh is the fallback.
FontsOne Google Fonts request, display=swap, with preconnect to both font hosts.The app's index.html already loads the same three families (plus Caveat). Don't load them a second time from the page.

Build plan

Verified in the repo: the app is a single file, app.tsx, rendered by index.html with React UMD and in-browser Babel. Theme uses useTheme() with localStorage["truex-theme"], and tokens live in the :root block of index.html. I did not find or verify a router. The route, API and analytics below are proposals.

1. Tokens

  • Add to index.html :root: the agent tints (--ice --ice-dot --mint --mint-dot --butter --butter-dot --peach --peach-dot --lilac --lilac-dot --tint-ink). They are fixed hex values with no dark variant.
  • Add the board-only tokens with both light and dark values: --board-bg --board-dot --glass --glass-hi --glass-line --sheen --obj-shadow --obj-drop --noise. Values are in Color tokens.
  • Add the missing dark --shadow-sm (0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 30%)) to both dark blocks.

2. Components

ComponentPropsNotes
JoinInvitePagetoken: stringOwns the state machine, fetches the invite, renders the split layout. Renders the clover <clipPath> once.
InviterRowinviter, workspace, role, sentAt, expiresAt, expiredAvatar with a workspace logo badge, name, verified badge, role pill and expiry pill.
JoinCardstate, name, onName, onSubmit, email, workspaceNameThe .card.join form. Contains the parts below.
ProgressCheckupsteps: {label, status}[], value, badStatus is idle | on | busy | done | bad.
NameFieldvalue, onChange, error, readOnlyLive initials avatar and hint text.
JoinButtonlabel, busy, disabledShows a spinner when busy, otherwise the arrow.
StateBannerkind: "ok" | "warn", childrenRender text as React children. Don't use innerHTML.
CapabilitiesBoardworkspaceName, agentCount, teammate, teamCount, profile, hotParallax, timer and legend highlight. Pauses when hidden.
Specimen* (8)specimen-specificSpecimenAgent, SpecimenTimer, SpecimenGoals, SpecimenSearch, SpecimenStart, SpecimenTeammate, SpecimenProfile, SpecimenCustomAgents, plus the two bars.
CapabilityLegenditems, onHotEight static items. The 06 description uses the team count.

3. State machine

FromEventTo
loadingInvite fetched, valid, user not a membervalid
loadingInvite fetched, past expiryexpired
loadingSigned-in user already in the workspacemember
loadingToken invalid or revoked, or network errorerror
validSubmit with an invalid namevalid (field error shown)
validSubmit with a valid namesubmitting
submittingAccept succeedsjoined
submittingAccept failsvalid with an error banner, name kept
expiredRequest a new invite succeedsrequestSent
joined / memberOpen workspaceNavigate into the app

The three submit phase labels ("Verifying your invite", "Setting up your seat", "Opening your first conversation") are a fake 3 × 700ms sequence in the prototype. In production, show them while the real request is in flight: advance one label every 700ms, stop on the last label until the response arrives, and never keep the user waiting just to finish the animation.

4. Route, data and events (proposals)

  • Route: /join/:token. Signed-out users sign in first and return to this URL.
  • Data: GET the invite by token, POST accept with { name }, and POST request-new-invite. The payload shape is in Logic & wiring.
  • Analytics: invite_viewed (with state), invite_name_entered (first valid name), invite_joined, invite_join_failed, invite_expired_request.
  • Remove before shipping: the theme segmented control, the Preview state footer and the ?theme= query parameter.

5. Order of work

  1. Tokens in index.html.
  2. Left pane and the state machine with a mocked invite. Ship-ready on its own.
  3. Board materials (clover, glass, grain, lit, drop), then specimens 01 to 08, then the legend.
  4. Wire the real invite data (names, counts, expiry, teammate photo).
  5. Motion pause, reduced motion, accessibility fixes, QA.

QA and acceptance

Visual

  • At 1440×900 and 1280×760 the page has no scrollbar. The left pane, the board and the full legend fit in one screen.
  • Left content starts near the top: the inviter row sits about 7vh below the header (clamped 20 to 72px), not vertically centred.
  • Legend titles stay on one line, level with their 01 to 08 numbers. Descriptions wrap to 2 lines at most.
  • The legend has 4 columns at 1400px and above, 2 columns from 521 to 1399px, and 1 column at 520px and below.
  • Board specimens never overlap each other's labels at any desktop size. The board shrinks with the window height.
  • Light and dark both match the reference screenshots. Auto follows the OS setting.
  • At 400px wide the layout stacks with a 16px gutter and no horizontal scroll, and the board uses the 5 : 6.4 ratio.

Behaviour

  • Typing a name updates the input avatar, step 2, the progress bar (2 of 3), the hint ("looks good") and specimen 07 on every keystroke.
  • Submitting an empty or 1-character name shows the error, sets aria-invalid and focuses the field.
  • A valid submit shows the spinner and the phase labels, then the "You're in" banner, "Open Northwind Labs", 3 of 3, and 07 with a check and "joined just now".
  • Expired: red pill "Expired Sep 23", warning banner, "Request a new invite". After clicking, the success banner shows and the button is disabled.
  • Already a member: all steps done, "Open Northwind Labs", 07 shows Alex Rivera "member since Aug".
  • Hovering or focusing a legend item dims the other specimens to .3 and scales the matching one to 1.04.
  • With reduced motion on, nothing loops, there is no parallax, and the highlight still works.
  • The whole flow can be completed with the keyboard only.
